title: William Malone
data: My name is William Malone and I am an HTML5 game developer in the Denver, CO area. I created this site to provide a medium to test out the newest web technologies and give back to the design and developer community via open source articles. This step by step tutorial will describe how to make a sweet HTML5 game involving popsicles and destruction. Includes a downloadable demo and source code. This tutorial will show how to create a simple paint bucket tool on an HTML5 Canvas using JavaScript. We will be implementing a flood fill algorithm using the HTML5 imageData object for pixel manipulation.
